title: Colombia Earthquake 2026 Tracker Update — Aug 21, 2026
summary: President Abelardo de la Espriella signed Decree 1261 of 2026 on Aug 19, declaring a 30-day economic, social and ecological emergency across all 15 affected departments and granting the government extraordinary powers to fund reconstruction. UNGRD's latest count puts the toll at 319 dead, 4,506 injured, 260 missing and 364 rescued alive, with more than 30,000 homes destroyed and roughly 170,000 damaged across 476 municipios — sharply higher than the prior week's figures as the damage assessment widened. The departments-affected discrepancy in the Contested section is now resolved by the decree's formal list of 15 departments.
